question: Can you provide the top three races with the largest percentage differences between Google's 2021 overall hiring data from dar non intersectional hiring and the average percentages in the 2021 BLS data for the technology sectors specifically defined as 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals,' 'Software publishers,' 'Data processing, hosting, and related services,' or the industry group 'Computer systems design and related services,' along with their respective differences?
sql:
WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) as avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) as avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) as avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) as avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND industry IS NULL
    AND (
      (subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (subsector = 'Software publishers' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (subsector = 'Data processing, hosting, and related services' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
    )
)
SELECT 
  race,
  ROUND(google_pct * 100, 1) as google_pct,
  ROUND(bls_avg_pct * 100, 1) as bls_avg_pct,
  ROUND(abs_diff * 100, 1) as percentage_difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    'White' as race,
    g.race_white as google_pct,
    b.avg_white as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_white - b.avg_white) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Asian' as race,
    g.race_asian as google_pct,
    b.avg_asian as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_asian - b.avg_asian) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black or African American' as race,
    g.race_black as google_pct,
    b.avg_black as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_black - b.avg_black) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latinx' as race,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx as google_pct,
    b.avg_hispanic as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
)
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 3
